# Senior Front-end Developer (React / Next.js)

The Netherlands

Full-time

Permanent employee

## Your mission

* Design and build modern React / Next.js applications that stay maintainable as they grow.
* Make and defend architectural decisions — and understand the performance consequences of them.
* Set front-end standards, build reusable components, and create patterns the whole team builds on.
* Work closely with our back-end developers to integrate APIs and business logic cleanly.
* Own quality end to end, including in production: reading logs, tracing issues, and diagnosing incidents together with our DevOps and sysadmins rather than handing them off.
* Improve performance, accessibility, and overall UX across projects.
* Review code, raise the bar, and help good front-enders across our teams become even better — without slowing them down.

## Your profile

* 5+ years in front-end development, with deep, current React and TypeScript experience.
* Real production experience with Next.js — you understand rendering strategies (SSR / SSG / ISR / CSR), hydration, routing, and *when to use which*, not just how to scaffold an app.
* A strong grasp of front-end architecture: component design, state management, and how structural choices affect maintainability, bundle size, and runtime performance.
* The ability to measure and improve performance (Core Web Vitals, bundle analysis, profiling) — and to understand the cost of the trade-offs you make.
* Solid experience integrating front-ends with APIs and back-end systems.
* Comfort across the full lifecycle: version control, testing, debugging, CI/CD, deployment, and maintenance.
* Excellent English and the confidence to work directly with product owners and clients.
* Senior judgment: you know when to be rigorous and when to be pragmatic, you take ownership of outcomes, and you make the people around you better.

**Nice to have:** Python/Django and SQL (you'll work closely with our back-end teams), real depth in accessibility, a good design sensibility, or experience setting standards within a team.

## Why us?

* Challenging custom software projects.
* A highly skilled and technical team.
* Short communication lines and little bureaucracy.
* Significant influence on front-end architecture and development standards.
* Opportunities to improve processes and shape the future of front-end development within the company.
* A culture that values expertise, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* A salary between €3000 - €5000,- based on experience.
* A training budget for courses, certifications, and industry events.
* 25 vacation days to ensure sufficient rest and relaxation.
* An attractive (optional) pension plan in which we double your contribution.
* A company laptop and phone.
* Flexible working hours that you can arrange yourself.
* Hybrid working is fully supported.
* Fun outings with your team and the chance to challenge your colleagues to a game of table tennis, chess, or pool.

Remote Germany, Berlin, Hamburg, München, Prague

We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same.

In ecommerce we build on Shopify and Liquid and Next.js, with custom AWS microservices and apps that take Shopify well past the defaults. 

On the marketing side we build highly customised sites in Next.js and React, with careful design and animation and a real focus on how the page performs and feels. 

In automotive we build full platforms, from stock-car locators to configurators and more. Across all of it, we bring AI into the work through our own products.

Here nothing will be fixed. You will work across changing projects and settings, on long builds that run for months and shorter spikes to figure out how a business can actually use AI, and you will help us rethink how agency work is done.

Sound like your kind of place? Here is what we need from you.

Mindset

Is your goal to deliver great software, whether the problem is easy or hard? Do you push deeper than most to find the right solution, not just the first one that works? Then you are the person we need.

You bring your ideas, experience and your curiosity, you use AI to build better and faster, and you stand behind what you put your name on.

Drive

By now the drive is a track record, not a promise. You have years of hard problems behind you and it shows. You understand the whole stack, or you close any gap in it fast, and the hard problems are the ones you go looking for. You are the one who takes the piece nobody else can crack and finds a way through, then leaves the ground solid enough for everyone else to build on. What you bring to the table:

* You work across crafts, not in a corner. You are close with developers, designers, and strategists, and you would rather build in the open than behind a wall.

# Senior Software Engineer, Agentic TeamIsrael

Apply now

We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone.

### **The Role:**

The team is at the center of Aiven's move into agentic AI. We build the platform and tooling that let AI agents and developers work with data on Aiven, from the agent runtimes and the interfaces that connect large language models to real systems, to the product experiences on top of them. Our work ships fast, reaches customers and AI agents directly, and defines how Aiven's data platform is used in an AI-first world.

We are looking for an experienced full-stack engineer to help design and build these AI and agentic products end to end. You'll be part of a small, senior team that owns its work from idea to production. Our backend services are written in Python and TypeScript, our agents run on frontier LLMs, and our frontend uses React and TypeScript, all on top of Aiven's own data platform.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Writing high quality, maintainable code and releasing quality features
* Contributing to technical planning and backlog management
* Helping investigate and resolve customer issues
* Mentor and empower other engineers around you

### **What We're Looking For:**

**Must-have:**

* Excellent development skills in Python, TypeScript, and React
* Excellent understanding of Agentic AI systems
* Ability to independently solve challenges, break tasks and push to desired outcome
* Ability to write good automated tests
* Experience using Linux in development
* Fluency in English, verbal and written
* Deep, daily use of AI agents in your own development workflow: you go beyond Cursor or Claude Code as autocomplete, and build your own MCP servers, skills, custom tools and automated agent workflows to multiply your output.

**Nice to have:**

* Distributed systems knowledge

Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t line up perfectly – we still encourage you to apply! We believe in investing in our crabs’ professional growth.

### **Amazing! What’s next:**

If you think Aiven is the place for you and that our Values align with yours, send us your resume and we’ll get in touch!

### **Global Benefits:**

Our global benefits are designed to help you thrive and grow, personally and professionally:

We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone.

### **The Role:**

The team's mission is to build the definitive AI-Native Open Source Data Platform. They are integrating best-of-breed open-source technologies - starting with data governance and discovery (DataHub) and moving into unified federated querying - to deliver a seamless data experience in minutes, not months.

They aren't a typical corporate team. They operate like an early-stage startup inside Aiven: they move fast, iterate rapidly, and default to extreme ownership. Senior Software Engineers don't just own a product surface from ideation to production - they shape how the team builds, help resolve the hardest technical problems, and raise the bar for everyone around them.

They aren't just building for an AI-first future; they live in it. They expect candidates to be AI-First Engineers. This means actively using LLMs and agentic workflows to supercharge daily coding, automate mundane tasks, and optimize deployment pipelines. Senior engineers are also expected to bring this mindset to the team - identifying where AI-driven workflows can multiply the team's output and helping others adopt them.

# AI Engineer

**YOUR MISSION AT VOI**

As an AI Engineer at Voi, you will build and own the AI platform that our business depends on. Close to 400 colleagues use Voi’s AI platform every day, and teams across the company have already built over 300 apps on our in-house app-building platform.

This is a hands-on builder role in a small, senior team where your work will have company-wide impact. You will keep our existing AI platform fast, secure, and reliable, while building the next generation of capabilities that help Voi move faster, work smarter, and continue leading in applied AI.

You will:

* Own and improve Voi’s AI platform, including our in-house app-building platform, Claude stack and future AI capabilities.
* Build robust backend services and full-stack, user-facing features that make the platform reliable, scalable, and easy to use.
* Develop the next layer of AI infrastructure, such as agentic platforms, enterprise search, knowledge bases, knowledge graphs and open-weight model access.
* Strengthen security, identity and access control across the platform, including permissions, security reviews, audits and integrations with company systems.
* Work closely with the AI team, platform team and colleagues across Voi to understand needs, test ideas and ship useful tools quickly.
* Help decide what we build, buy or integrate, with a focus on control, long-term value and avoiding vendor lock-in.
* Explore the AI landscape and bring promising ideas into the platform when they are ready to scale.

**WHAT YOU NEED TO EMBARK**

We are looking for an experienced engineer who enjoys building platforms that many people rely on. You combine strong backend skills with product thinking, sound judgement, and the ability to work closely with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

We believe you bring:

* Strong experience building and running robust, scalable internal platforms, ideally including AI platforms.
* A solid backend engineering background, with experience building applications and services at scale.
* Hands-on experience with LLMs in production, such as agents, tool use, MCP, RAG, search or evaluation.
* Full-stack ability and a good sense of UX, especially when building tools for non-engineers.
* Good understanding of identity, authentication and access control, or a strong interest in going deeper in this area.
* A practical builder mindset, with the ability to turn ideas into working software and iterate quickly.
* Autonomy, ownership and good judgement in open-ended technical areas.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to different audiences.

Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box.
